comparison.objective: Measure three cans with a slow thermometer and reject the warmest; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential probe/plate placement, waiting for settled readings, comparison, and sorting versus blade alignment and coordinated wire-tool withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Correct warmest can identified from settled measurements and released on the reject mat; candidate requires undamaged selective extraction, with numeric limits absent.
comparison.reason: Measurement-driven sorting tests a different ability from mechanical release.
